newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Sugar buys 10,000T U.S. corn at tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Sugar buys 10,000T U.S. corn at tender.

text.p: State-owned Taiwan Sugar Corp on Friday bought a 10,000-tonne position of No.2 or better U.S. yellow corn from Marubeni Corp, traders said.
The shipment was bought on a cost-and-freight basis at 89.75 U.S. cents per tonne over December Chicago futures, traders said.
The shipment was slated for delivery from December 10-31 from the U.S. Gulf of Mexico or January 1-20 from the Pacific Northwest, they added.
The shipment is the state firm's first buy on a cost-and-freight futures basis, traders said.
Traders said Friday's shipment had been pre-approved by Taiwan's Ministry of Economic Affairs and the Ministry of Transportation and Communications.
Traders said Taiwan Sugar would also tender soon for another combined shipment of 18,000-tonne U.S. corn and 12,000-tonne U.S. soybeans slated for delivery between late October and early November.
